claims: Oklahoma City is the capital of Oklahoma.
Oklahoma City is the largest city of Oklahoma.
Oklahoma City has a population of approximately 630,000 residents, according to Visit The USA.
Oklahoma City's living expenses are 18% lower than the national average.
Oklahoma City's housing is 41.3% lower than the national average.
The Oklahoma City National Memorial honors victims of the 1995 bombing.
Bricktown is a former warehouse district turned into a vibrant entertainment district.
RIVERSPORT Rapids is a whitewater rafting and adventure center.
Oklahoma City has a 3.1% unemployment rate.
Oklahoma City is home to the OKC Thunder NBA team.
Oklahoma City was founded during the Land Run of 1889.
